title: Stage 2 S2-2: what the expressive head (-X) costs, per body, against today's head
plan: STAGE2_PLAN.md section 3 (S2-2); DECISION_LOG P29 (nothing adopted, P24; P2's jaw deferral stands)

rules.statics: sizing.requirements with each case's sizing settings (refine._init) on the body rebuilt from its record (refs.source): the hold is the quasi-static single-support hold (statics.single_support_hold: one foot lifted 0.05 H, the centre of mass over the stance pad, the trunk's roll searched over +-6 deg; DEFINITIONS.md 'Single-support hold'), the largest of both sides' |torque| on the drive's coordinate; double_support the static torque at home on both feet; rms the nominal walk's; the ratios over the drive's sustained planning torque A1 (catalog.SUSTAINED_FRACTION 0.57 x rated); cont = max(rms, hold) / A1, the sizing's continuous requirement.  'at_todays_pose': the -X body posed at today's home (the new joints at 0), as refine.head_x_at_pick_pose; mass and centre of mass from the compiled model (statics.Model)
rules.walks: each reference regenerated (refs.generate: gait.generate and gait.inverse_dynamics at round two's accuracy, the record's model and home) and checked equal to Stage 1's saved arrays; its drive ratios by envelope._ratios against the record's drives at the record's bus (rms / A1, 1.25 x peak / planning peak, 1.15 x speed / speed at the bus); passive: tau + damping x rate + friction loss x sign(rate) on the head and tail drives (informational: Stage 0 leaves the MJCF's damping and friction out); contact from the inverse dynamics (single-support centre-of-pressure margin; the split's largest per-foot friction ratio, with the lighter loaded foot's share of the weight at that frame) and the split-free friction need of the whole robot (|horizontal| / vertical of m (a_com - g)); clearance.screen (gates r2) with the reference standing in for the nominal walk, on the round-two MJCF; a ratio moves when the heads differ by at least 0.005 of the limit
rules.moves: minimum-jerk profiles (q = A (10 s^3 - 15 s^4 + 6 s^5), s = t / T; peak rate 1.875 A / T) at the -X body's standing home (full precision, refs.source), the other joints at home.  inverse_dynamics: the trunk held still, (M qdd + qfrc_bias) on the joint's dof (mj_fullM, armature included) plus the MJCF's joint damping x rate and friction loss x sign(rate) (the compiled model's dof_damping, dof_frictionloss); its parts at the peak; the neck-pitch torque over the move; what the feet must take to hold the trunk still (the free joint's generalized force: the horizontal force and the yaw moment about the vertical through the support centre, the move's inertia only, the passive terms being internal).  plant: plant.build on the hard floor (settled), the head brought to the start and settled, then the move commanded every 2 ms step (Plant.command: target, rate and the rigid-body feedforward, without damping or friction, as Stage 1's references), no delay; read: the servo's actuator force (the plant's envelope applied), the tracking error, the trunk's yaw.  Ratios: peak over the planning peak, raw and x 1.25 (sizing.PEAK_MARGIN); speed over the rated speed, raw and x 1.15 (sizing.SPEED_MARGIN); RMS over the move and over the busiest gaze rhythm (one shift every 2 s, the hold between free of gravity on a vertical yaw axis) over A1, which is a heat limit over minutes, not seconds.  fastest: the shortest duration whose peak torque and peak rate are within the limit (bisection on the inverse dynamics; both fall as the move slows); the plant's sweep runs each 0.6 rad move again at the durations of PLANT_SWEEP and reads the fastest within there
